name: Patronus AI
tagline: Patronus AI is an automated LLM evaluation platform that helps teams test, red-team, and monitor AI applications for accuracy, hallucination, toxicity, and compliance. It provides pre-built and custom evaluators and integrates into CI/CD pipelines for continuous AI quality assurance.
